# BlogFrPage: its buttons, fields and dropdowns

What the crawl saw on pages of this type that a visitor can use (links are in
ai/GLOSSARY.md), read only: nothing was clicked, typed or sent. Each locator matched exactly one element
on the page it was read from. Those it trusts are already in `BlogFrElements`, each with the method
that uses it; a fragile one (its locator counts positions) is not, and has a line to paste into the
**elements** YOURS block once checked against a saved page (ai/recipes/add-an-element.md). Controls on most pages (a footer form) are in
controls/Everywhere.md. Not listed: anything that appears only after a click, behind a login, or
after a form is sent; ask for a saved page of that.

## Header

- **`Français (FR)`**: `button`. Seen on 3 of 3 crawled pages. In `BlogFrElements` as `FRANCAIS_FR_BUTTON`: `click().francaisFr()`.
- **`Se connecter`**: `button`. Seen on 3 of 3 crawled pages. In `BlogFrElements` as `SE_CONNECTER_BUTTON`: `click().seConnecter()`.
- **`Tarifs`**: `button`. Seen on 3 of 3 crawled pages. In `BlogFrElements` as `TARIFS_BUTTON`: `click().tarifs()`.
- **`Essayer gratuitement`**: `button`. Seen on 3 of 3 crawled pages. In `BlogFrElements` as `ESSAYER_GRATUITEMENT_BUTTON`: `click().essayerGratuitement()`.
